_meta.task: #138 — pre-registered classification of the 28 #134 queries by GOLD-CHUNK RHETORICAL FORM.
_meta.why: Orchestrator hypothesis: corpus documents the FIXED state, agent searches by SYMPTOM. If true, gold chunks written in symptom->cause->fix form should be retrieved better than gold chunks written as 'what we fixed' announcements.
_meta.protocol: Labels assigned by READING the gold chunk text only (data/bench138_golds.txt), BEFORE running any retrieval measurement. Labels are a property of the DOCUMENT FORM, not of the query and not of the result.
_meta.pass_fail_fixed_before_run: Group difference in MRR is meaningful ONLY if it exceeds the metric's own split-half noise measured on this same n=28 sample (median 0.1048 per #135). Below that -> NOT PROVEN, per #135 discipline.

label_values.symptom_first: Text names the FAILURE/symptom in the same voice an agent would complain in ('X ломается', 'не обновляется', 'блокирует', 'конфликтует'). Includes Грабли-style symptom->cause->fix and bug reports.
label_values.fixed_state: Text announces the RESOLVED state or the shipped change ('роль возвращается', 'shipped', '### Fixed', 'теперь загорается только когда'). The defect appears only as past tense / implied.
label_values.neutral_ref: Descriptive/reference material with no failure framing at all: API docs, tables, config semantics, pricing, contracts, plans.
